claim: ADR 0340 lane 1: supabase/migrations/20270107200000_a_menu_keeps_the_houses_own_sections.sql enables row level security on public.menu_sections and public.menu_section_changes and revokes ALL on both from anon and authenticated, with no client policy; only service_role is granted (ADR 0340 rule 6, OD-72/94). The verify reads that file's text; scripts/check_new_tables_are_locked_down.py is the corpus-wide check
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('supabase/migrations/20270107200000_a_menu_keeps_the_houses_own_sections.sql').read(); ok=all(re.search(p%n,t) for n in ('menu_sections','menu_section_changes') for p in (r'ALTER\s+TABLE\s+public\.%s\s+ENABLE\s+ROW\s+LEVEL\s+SECURITY',r'REVOKE\s+ALL\s+ON\s+public\.%s\s+FROM\s+anon\s*,\s*authenticated')) and not re.search(r'CREATE\s+POLICY',t,re.I); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

claim: ADR 0340 lane 1 (rule 7, F20): supabase/migrations/20270107200000_a_menu_keeps_the_houses_own_sections.sql adds two CHECKs on menu_items: a dish line (line_kind 'dish') has no bottle_price or by_glass_price (menu_items_a_dish_has_no_drink_price), and only a dish line has a price (menu_items_only_a_dish_has_a_price), so no bottle_price reader can read a dish's price. The verify reads the two constraint names and their predicates in that file; supabase/tests/20270107200000 T8 exercises them
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('supabase/migrations/20270107200000_a_menu_keeps_the_houses_own_sections.sql').read(); sys.exit(0 if re.search(r\"menu_items_a_dish_has_no_drink_price\s+CHECK\s*\(\s*line_kind\s+IS\s+DISTINCT\s+FROM\s+'dish'\s+OR\s*\(\s*bottle_price\s+IS\s+NULL\s+AND\s+by_glass_price\s+IS\s+NULL\s*\)\",t) and re.search(r\"menu_items_only_a_dish_has_a_price\s+CHECK\s*\(\s*price\s+IS\s+NULL\s+OR\s*\(\s*coalesce\(\s*line_kind\s*=\s*'dish'\s*,\s*false\s*\)\",t) else 1)"

claim: ADR 0340 lane 1 (rule 21, S202): the latest migration defining public.current_menu_line_follows_house_price reads mudavym.menu_price_menu_id and excludes only that menu (m.id IS DISTINCT FROM v_origin) in both its UPDATEs, and skips dish lines; a change with source 'import' or 'menu_current' that names no menu still follows nowhere (the deviation recorded in ADR 0340's lane 1 note). The verify reads the latest function text for the setting, two origin exclusions and two dish exclusions; supabase/tests/20270107400000 T1-T3 exercise it
verify: python3 -c "import re,glob,sys; fs=sorted(f for f in glob.glob('supabase/migrations/*.sql') if re.search(r'FUNCTION\s+public\.current_menu_line_follows_house_price\s*\(',open(f).read(),re.I)); t=open(fs[-1]).read() if fs else ''; m=re.search(r'FUNCTION\s+public\.current_menu_line_follows_house_price\s*\(',t,re.I); b=t[m.start():t.find('\$\$;',m.end())] if m else ''; sys.exit(0 if 'mudavym.menu_price_menu_id' in b and len(re.findall(r'm\.id\s+IS\s+DISTINCT\s+FROM\s+v_origin',b))>=2 and len(re.findall(r\"line_kind\s+IS\s+DISTINCT\s+FROM\s+'dish'\",b))>=2 else 1)"

claim: ADR 0340 lane 1 (rule 5): the latest migration that sets a default on restaurant_menus.status sets it to 'draft' (20270107100000_a_house_has_one_live_menu_per_kind.sql; the baseline default was 'active'), so a menu written without a status is never live by accident. The verify reads migration text in version order; it does not read production
verify: python3 -c "import re,glob,sys; d=[x for f in sorted(glob.glob('supabase/migrations/*.sql')) for x in re.findall(r'ALTER\s+TABLE\s+(?:ONLY\s+)?public\.restaurant_menus\s+ALTER\s+COLUMN\s+status\s+SET\s+DEFAULT\s+\'(\w+)\'',open(f).read(),re.I)]; sys.exit(0 if d and d[-1]=='draft' else 1)"
